Package dayplanner

Class Tester

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Tester
public class Tester extends Object
Automatic tester that executes test cases for DayPlanner features, invariants, and exceptions.

      public static boolean testCase36()

    • testCase37

      public static boolean testCase37()
      Case 37: Verifies effective use of polymorphism through dynamic binding. Given an ArrayList<Activity> containing HomeActivity, SchoolActivity, and OtherActivity objects, all details are displayed polymorphically via toString() without checking class types or using instanceof.
      Returns:
      true if the test passes, false otherwise.
